{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted only once
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check unique sites
unique_sites = df_dedup['site'].unique()
print(f"Unique sites after deduplication: {unique_sites}")
print(f"Number of unique sites: {len(unique_sites)}")

# Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print(f"Response rates by site:\n{response_rate_by_site}")"}
